title: DSH Plugin Index
description: Every npm package tagged dsh-plugin, generated from registry metadata. Each version carries engines.dsh so the Discover tab shows which versions fit your runtime. engines.dsh is taken from the package when the author declares it, and otherwise derived from the package's own @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peerDependencies (those ship in lockstep with the runtime). Derived ranges are marked by the "Derived DSH range" label; treat them as a pointer, not a promise.
